snapshot.text: State-run, tax-funded health system inherited from the Soviet model. The government adopted a new state programme, Healthy Nation, for 2026–2030, and is building a centralised electronic health record system.

priorities.title: State programme Healthy Nation 2026–2030
priorities.text: The five-year state programme sets the health system's goals to 2030.

priorities.title: Rural healthcare
priorities.text: The president has stressed quality medical care in rural areas.
